subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  5 = 5 Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Character is i. breeds i. to bear a good character. (b) It ii. the supreme place of ii. asset of a man. (c) A man of iii. an invaluable iii. acceptance in society by dint of a good character. (d) He occupies iv. should try our best iv. is respected by all. (e) So, all of us v. good character v. all other noble qualities.
guide_solution: (a) Character is an invaluable asset of a man. (b) It breeds all other noble qualities. (c) A man of good character is respected by all. (d) He occupies the supreme place of acceptance in society by dint of a good character. (e) So, all of us should try our best to bear a good character.
